summary: Run unit tests with ansible-test units --docker -v over the whole codebase, a single module, a specific Python version, or a full file path for non-module code. Opening a PR also runs relevant tests in CI.
questions: How do I run unit tests for just one module?
How do I run Ansible unit tests on a particular Python version?
How do I run unit tests for module_utils?
Which Docker image should I use for unit tests?

answer_card.title: Run ansible-core unit tests
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
cd /path/to/ansible/source && source hacking/env-setup
ansible-test units --docker -v                 # everything
ansible-test units --docker -v apt             # one module
ansible-test units --docker -v --python 3.13 apt
ansible-test units --docker -v test/units/module_utils/basic/test_imports.py
```
Use the default image (`--docker` or `--docker default`). A pull request also triggers the relevant tests in CI.
